prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1080; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the injured party in connection with the side-impact collision that occurred at a signalized intersection involving your insured. Our client sustained significant injuries in the incident and is currently receiving medical treatment. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, either by telephone, in writing, or in person.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to your insured, along with a certified copy of the declarations page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please also confirm the name of the adjuster assigned to this claim.

Please ensure that all evidence relating to the collision is preserved in its current condition. This includes vehicle data and event data recorder information, photographs, dashcam or surveillance footage, witness statements, repair estimates, telematics data, and the claim file. Any destruction or alteration of such material could prejudice our client's claim, and we expect your cooperation in maintaining it.
